grades: Current high school student returning in the fall (not a rising 9th grader, not a senior)
notes: Located in Washington, DC, so it is a commute for Maryland teens. Check back in February 2027 for the application.
name: Summer High School Volunteer Program
city: Washington, DC (main hospital, Michigan Avenue NW)
what_you_do: Six-week summer volunteer session at the hospital. Greet patients and visitors, help with wayfinding, round with the hospitality cart, and finish a group project.
who_can_apply: 15 or older by the start of the program, and a current high school student who returns to high school in the fall. The page does not set a residency rule.
duration: 6 weeks, 2 shifts a week (Tue/Wed or Wed/Thu), 10am to 3pm
deadline_text: The application is closed. The page says to check back in February 2027. 2027 session dates are to be determined.
how_to_apply: Online application with one professional reference (name and email).
